Detailed Description

XVista TV Display Functions.

High-level functions that call the myzimage functions for image display. Most applications will call these functions rather than the low-level myzimage routines.

float  z1,
float  z2,
int  flip,
int  erase,
int  color
) 
 

load an image onto the image display

Parameters:
a Input floating image array
nx Number of X-axis pixels to be displayed
ny Number of Y-axis pixels to be displayed
nxfull Number of X-axis pixels in the full frame
isx Address of the first X-axis pixel to be displayed (usually 0 = first pixel)
isy Address of the first Y-axis pixel to be displayed (usually 0 = first pixel)
psx X-axis image-space coordinate corresponding to isx (typically, if isx=0, psx=1)
psy Y-axis image-space coordinate corresponding to isy (typically, if isy=0, psy=1)
z1 Intensity mapping lower limit
z2 Intensity mapping upper limit
flip Flag for up/down image reflection (1=Y increases up, 0=Y increases down or native screen memory order)
erase Flag to erase screen before display
color Color plane to load (1=R,2=G,3=B,0=all)
Loads an image into the image display, mapping data values into colors.

) 
 

Open the XTV display.

Parameters:
nx Width of the image display window in screen pixels
ny Height of the image display window in screen pixels
nclrs number of colors to use
zoomf zoom factor for the zoom window (0=no zoom window)
parity 1=flip Y-axis, 0=native order
resource string with the resource variable (e.g., xtv.geometry)
title title to appear on the window top banner
Returns:
file descriptor of X events on success
Opens the XTV image display with the requested properties
